notes: apra-fleet-fyc.3.2 (commit c8e32b7): single new file packages/apra-fleet-se/test/fyc3-se-package-json-shipped.test.mjs (96 lines), exactly where the bead asked; no other file touched by this bead. All acceptance criteria verified by hand. Placement/conventions: matches the existing suite style (node:test describe/test, node:assert, fs/os/path, __dirname via fileURLToPath, bead-id comment header) - compared against packages/apra-fleet-se/test/contracts-schema-packaging.test.mjs. Runner pickup: the se package's own test script globs test/*.test.mjs via node --test, and ci.yml line 114 runs 'npm test --workspaces --if-present' after the root build (line 45-46) and root vitest (line 101), so the file is picked up in CI; root vitest deliberately does not collect *.test.mjs (ci.yml ~line 105 comment), so this step is its only coverage. Executed standalone: 'node --test test/fyc3-se-package-json-shipped.test.mjs' -> 3/3 pass in 1.15s, far under the 5-minute single-file budget. Negative verification (the load-bearing criterion): I removed "packages/apra-fleet-se/package.json" from root package.json's files array, re-ran the file, got 'not ok 1 - static allowlist assertion' with pass 2 / fail 1, then restored package.json and confirmed 'git diff --stat package.json' is empty. Test 2 genuinely exercises the extraction path rather than reading the developer's pre-populated home: it mkdtemps a temp HOME, sets both HOME and USERPROFILE (correct on win32, where os.homedir() reads USERPROFILE), cache-busts the dist/cli/{install,workflow-assets,config}.js imports so config.js captures the temp homedir, then asserts manifest.builtinWorkflows has key 'fleet-sprint/package.json' and that the extracted WORKFLOWS_DIR/fleet-sprint/package.json declares "type":"module"; I independently confirmed WORKFLOWS_DIR resolves to <fake>/.apra-fleet/workflows when USERPROFILE is set, so it cannot pass against my real ~/.apra-fleet. Cleanup is in a finally block that restores both env vars and rmSync's the temp dir. Hygiene: file is ASCII, LF line endings (file(1) reports 'ASCII text', no CRLF), no shell helper added, no temp/scratch files, no secrets. Regressions: 'npm test' (root vitest) exit 0 - 204 files passed, 7 skipped, 199.03s; git status shows no modified tracked files (only my own untracked .fleet-review-*.json review artifacts). Notes-only, non-blocking: (a) Test 3 is oriented backwards for the regression it names. It asserts no files-allowlist entry lives INSIDE the excluded dirs (entry === 'packages/apra-fleet-se/test' or startsWith it), but the realistic future regression is the opposite shape - someone adding 'packages/apra-fleet-se/' wholesale to files, which equals neither excluded literal and would therefore pass this test while shipping test/. The bead itself suggested the stronger form ('assert against the resolved file list rather than packing'), and manifest.builtinWorkflows keys are already in hand at line 51, so asserting no key starts with 'fleet-sprint/test/' or 'fleet-sprint/sprint-logs/' would be a cheap upgrade. Also note packages/apra-fleet-se/sprint-logs/ does not exist in the tree today, so that half of the assertion is vacuous regardless. This does not violate any listed acceptance criterion, so it is a note rather than a reopen. (b) Only test 1 is load-bearing for the allowlist regression; test 2 reads packages/apra-fleet-se from disk via buildDevManifest, so it still passes with the files entry removed (confirmed in the negative run) - worth knowing for whoever maintains this pin. (c) Test 2 requires a built dist/ (it imports dist/cli/install.js); root pretest only runs build:contract, so outside CI a developer running the se suite on a never-built checkout would see an import error rather than a clean skip. Not a false-pass risk, since buildDevManifest reads the real source tree. (d) I did not run the full apra-fleet-se workspace suite: per ci.yml lines 51-79 it needs a working bd CLI and shells out to real CLIs; I ran the new file standalone plus the full root suite. (e) The other files in the diff range (ci.yml, docs/npm-packaging.md, package-lock.json, package.json, deletion of scripts/smoke-test-runner-import.mjs) belong to fyc.2.1/fyc.2.2/fyc.3.1, already reviewed; nothing unjustifiable and no scaffold slipped in.
